title: Mailbox status says "heldBehindPausedQueue" when the recipient is merely compacting context — name the real blocking cause and keep "paused" for a deliberate pause with its release condition
outcome: Mailbox status says "heldBehindPausedQueue" when the recipient is merely compacting context — name the real blocking cause and keep "paused" for a deliberate pause with its release condition
acceptance: The send receipt's notificationDisposition and the exact-message currentStatus name the ACTUAL reason a wake is held, for example the recipient compacting its context (resumes automatically), an operator pause (with its release condition), or provider capacity. 'Paused' appears only when a deliberate pause is in effect.

Behavioural tests drive each blocking cause that sets the auto-dispatch block and assert the distinct disposition and summary text class (not exact prose). Existing dispositions and wake semantics are otherwise unchanged.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact committed tree that lands.
